projects.title: Featured
projects.description: Some of the work we have done for our clients

tiendaOnline.title: Premium Online Store
tiendaOnline.description: E-commerce platform with payment gateway and real-time inventory management.
tiendaOnline.fullDescription: Complete e-commerce platform with integrated payment gateway (Stripe, PayPal), real-time inventory management, advanced admin panel, dynamic catalog with smart filters, coupon and discount system, persistent shopping cart, and complete SEO optimization.

deliveryApp.title: Delivery App
deliveryApp.description: Mobile application for order management and deliveries with integrated GPS tracking.
deliveryApp.fullDescription: Complete mobile application for order management and deliveries with real-time GPS tracking. Includes push notification system, driver ratings, order history, multiple payment methods, real-time chat.

sistemaErp.title: ERP System
sistemaErp.description: Comprehensive management system with inventory, sales, purchasing and reporting modules.
sistemaErp.fullDescription: Comprehensive ERP system with 15 specialized modules: inventory, sales, purchasing, accounting, human resources, CRM, electronic invoicing, advanced reports, and real-time executive dashboard.

dashboardAnalytics.title: Analytics Dashboard
dashboardAnalytics.description: Control panel with real-time data visualization and customized KPIs.
dashboardAnalytics.fullDescription: Advanced control panel for real-time business data visualization. More than 50 customizable widgets, configurable KPIs, automatic alerts, scheduled reports.

plataformaEducativa.title: Educational Platform
plataformaEducativa.description: Learning system with video conferencing and interactive assessments.
plataformaEducativa.fullDescription: Complete online learning platform with integrated video conferencing (WebRTC), interactive assessments, gamification system with points and badges, verifiable digital certificates.

chatbotIa.title: AI Chatbot
chatbotIa.description: Virtual assistant with natural language processing for 24/7 support.
chatbotIa.fullDescription: Intelligent virtual assistant with advanced natural language processing. Multi-channel integration (WhatsApp, Messenger, Web), custom training with business data.

appFintech.title: Fintech App
appFintech.description: Personal financial management application with bank connection.
appFintech.fullDescription: Personal finance application with automatic bank synchronization, intelligent expense categorization with AI, personalized budgets, savings goals.

marketplaceB2b.title: B2B Marketplace
marketplaceB2b.description: Wholesale commerce platform with customized catalogs.
marketplaceB2b.fullDescription: Complete B2B marketplace for wholesale commerce with customer-specific catalogs, automatic quotes, business credit management.

sistemaReservas.title: Booking System
sistemaReservas.description: Appointment and booking management platform for professional services.
sistemaReservas.fullDescription: SaaS appointment and booking management system for clinics, beauty salons, offices and professional services. Smart calendar with real-time availability.

iotDashboard.title: IoT Dashboard
iotDashboard.description: Industrial monitoring system with real-time sensors.
iotDashboard.fullDescription: Industrial IoT monitoring platform supporting more than 1000 simultaneous sensors, real-time visualization, predictive alerts based on machine learning.

xpinnit.title: Xpinnit
xpinnit.description: Goal, task and event management platform organized by sprints, multi-user.
xpinnit.fullDescription: Xpinnit ("Set goals. Take action.") is a productivity SaaS platform to define goals and execute them through sprints. It includes event boards, multi-user task assignment with owners and progress, per-event invitations, progress tracking and task export to PDF and Excel.

laAgencia.title: La Agencia — Ticketing
laAgencia.description: Travel ticketing and sales management system, with calendar and reports.
laAgencia.fullDescription: End-to-end ticketing system for a travel agency: real-time stats dashboard (clients, orders, profit goals), trip calendar in list and monthly views, sales records with client and route data, user management and export reports to Excel and PDF. Multi-language interface.
